{{Quote|The distress signal is coming from here&mdash;Meridian sector, Cybloc system.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Revival (episode)">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Cybloc system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cybloc]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] there was a space station in the system.
